entities.summary: Peter London (b. 1982-09-28, Brännkyrka parish) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Brännkyrka parish and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
